name: Sao Tome and Principe

findings.summary: Starlink activated retail satellite broadband in Sao Tome and Principe on 11 December 2025, its 26th African market, with standard and mini kits and residential plans priced in dobras and available immediately.
findings.analyst_inference: SpaceX controls constellation and terminals, so pole us. Tier 5 as a live commercial service; neither opened source names the licensing authority or subscriber numbers, so national scale reflects availability, not adoption. Both reports trace to Starlink's own announcement.

findings.controller: Atlas Sovereign Smart Solutions LLC (UAE joint venture of IOPn and Betabytes)
findings.local_actor: Citizenship and Investment Unit (CIU), via STP Service & Advisory FZCO
findings.summary: The country's citizenship-by-investment unit signed an MoU with a UAE joint venture for a modular data centre, an Nvidia-certified AI academy, a blockchain-based AI factory and digital identity systems, citing up to USD 10bn over a decade.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third on the UAE counterparty as prospective owner-operator; ownership of any facility not stated. Tier 1 MoU; USD 10bn is an aspirational 'up to' figure far beyond the economy's size and should be heavily discounted. Signatory is the CIU's agent, not a ministry. Nvidia mention is a certification, not an accelerator purchase, so no silicon finding. Single specialist crypto-press source; no independent corroboration found.

silicon.null_reason: no accelerator purchase or deployment found; only an Nvidia certification mention in the STP-002 MoU

models.null_reason: no national partnership with a model provider or sovereign model found in one dedicated search

applications.null_reason: no safe-city or surveillance procurement found; AidData hits were Cabo Verde safe city and a 2020 PRC broadcast-equipment donation to TVS (out of scope)

research_gaps: Radio/core equipment vendors for CST (4G launched Aug 2023, 102 antennas at 34 sites) and Unitel STP (4G May 2023) not stated in any opened source.
